world.description: Decide whether a and b are connected by the exposed reversible rewrites, on the stated promise distribution.

registration.name: matched/padded challenge
registration.order: fully realized lists permuted by separate sealed-matched-order-v2 and sealed-natural-order-v2 PRF streams
registration.support: first representative per label in each matched class; all unequal-fold ordered pairs of words length 1..4; positive seeded rule walks length <=4; retain joint-feature AND nuisance classes containing both labels, at most 32 classes in a seeded order; duplicate each with an identity prefix for the large stratum
registration.quotients: all proper two-sided congruences of the ambient monoid, jointly with exact ordered symbol-count vectors
registration.matching: exact joint length/length/histogram-L1/edit/LCS class balance within the LP
registration.objective: maximize the minimum support-point weight to avoid a four-pair extreme-point artifact
registration.rounding: largest remainders independently by label and scale, then independently verify every ceiling and nuisance equality; no repair

pairedDependence.kind: neutral-prefix copies of the same short cores

analyticOracle.argument: 4K weights sum to one, so min weight <=1/(4K); paired uniform weights attain it
